description: crypto.jobs (jobs): search. Every tool maps to a documented endpoint.

tools.name: search
tools.description: crypto.jobs RSS 2.0 feed (latest 50 jobs). query is not sent (the feed documents no search parameter) - filter the returned postings client-side; the feed answers its whole current list in one response, so ignore next_page (page 2 is the same list). title is '<Role> at <Company>'; description (HTML) starts with Company / Location lines; category stays in raw. id is the posting link (with utm parameters).
